title: Abdolominus
summary: Raleigh names Abdolominus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Balonymus, whom Curtius calls Abdolominus, Iustine Abdolomius, and Plutarch Alynomus, made King of Zidon from his garden. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
